hero.title: File:Rineen Monument.JPG
hero.description: Monument for the attack at Rineen during the Irish War of Independence. Rineen is a small settlement near Miltown Malbay, on the road to Lahinch. Black & Tans went beserk and burned many houses in both towns. Monument designed by Walter Kiernan.
